title: Data Entry Administrator
company: Recruitment Solutions (North West) Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
These are exciting times for our client, who is currently undergoing major change at their UK site. To support day-to-day operations and the transition to a new system, we are looking to recruit someone for a long-term assignment with a strong focus on high-volume data entry, invoice processing and data accuracy.

What you will be doing:
- Inputting and processing high volumes of invoices onto the new system.
- Accurately entering, matching and coding invoice information.
- Checking data for accuracy and resolving discrepancies.
- Updating and maintaining records within internal systems.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any differences.
- Assisting with payment-related administration and processing.
- Supporting the team with data queries, ensuring information is processed accurately and deadlines are met.

What you need to bring:
- Previous experience in high-volume data entry, data processing or invoice administration is essential.
- Experience processing large volumes of transactions, ideally within a fast-paced retail or similar environment.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when entering information.
- Ability to work efficiently with large amounts of data while meeting deadlines.
- Confident using computer systems and inputting information quickly and accurately.
- Able to work independently while contributing to a busy team environment.
- Experience working with invoices, purchase ledger or foreign currencies would be an advantage.

What you can expect:
- The opportunity to work within a global business.
- A long-term assignment during an exciting period of business change.
- A supportive team environment with opportunities to develop your experience.
- On-site parking.

title: Credit Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Credit Controller to join a fast-paced business within its established finance team based in Chadderton (Oldham). This is a hands-on role where you will take ownership of the full cash collection process across a portfolio of customers, with a strong focus on reducing outstanding debt, maintaining healthy cash flow and improving DSO.
Your new role:-

As Credit Controller, you will manage your own customer portfolio and take responsibility for ensuring payments are collected within agreed terms. You will work proactively to resolve outstanding balances, maintain accurate customer accounts and support the wider credit function in achieving its monthly and quarterly targets.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Proactively contacting customers to secure payment of outstanding invoices.
- Working towards monthly and quarterly cash collection targets, with particular focus on reducing debt aged over 30 days.
- Managing and reconciling customer accounts, ensuring ledgers remain accurate and up to date.
- Investigating and resolving write-offs, journals, unallocated cash and duplicate accounts on a monthly basis.
- Building and maintaining positive working relationships with both customers and internal colleagues.
- Identifying accounts that may require legal action and making timely recommendations to the Credit Control Manager.
- Maintaining clear and detailed collection notes within the internal finance system.
- Providing accurate information to support departmental cash forecasting.
- Contributing ideas and suggestions to improve processes and support continuous improvement within the department.
- Assisting with system testing and automation projects when required.
- Supporting the wider team with additional ad hoc duties as necessary.

What you'll need to succeed:-

To be considered for this position, you will have:
- Credit Control experience, ideally gained within a fast-paced B2 B environment.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage and prioritise a busy workload.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating at all levels both over the telephone and face to face.
- A professional and customer-focused approach.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- The ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
- Good problem-solving skills with the confidence to use your own initiative.
- Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.

What you'll get in return:-

Monday to Friday 9.00-5.30
Collaborative supportive team environment
20 days holidays + bank holidays
This is a great opportunity to join a busy and collaborative credit function where you can take ownership of your ledger, contribute to cash collection performance and play an active role in improving processes across the department.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Finance Officer
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Finance Officer
An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Finance Officer to join a well-established, privately owned multi-site organisation operating within a people-focused sector based in the Oldham area. This is an environment where trust, integrity and accuracy are paramount, and where the finance team plays an important role in supporting the wider organisation.
This is a varied, hands-on finance role offering exposure across transactional accounting, month-end and management information, working closely with senior members of the finance team and Directors.

The Role
You will support the day-to-day accounting requirements across multiple sites and group entities, helping to ensure accurate financial reporting and efficient financial processes.
- Processing purchase invoices, expenses and supplier payments
- Supplier statement reconciliations and resolving queries
- Sales ledger invoicing, cash allocation and credit control
- Processing and coding daily bank transactions
- Preparing bank reconciliations across multiple accounts
- Supporting weekly and monthly payroll processes
- Preparing journals, accruals and prepayments
- Completing balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations
- Assisting with monthly management accounts and MI reporting
- Supporting continuous improvement of finance processes and systems

About You
You will have previous experience in a varied accounts or finance role, ideally covering purchase ledger, sales ledger, bank reconciliations and month-end management accounts. A good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and strong Sage and Excel skills are required. You will be organised, accurate and proactive, with the ability to manage a varied workload and work effectively as part of a small finance team and Directors, where an empathetic and team-orientated approach is preferred.

What's on Offer
This is a great opportunity to join a successful multi-site organisation and gain broad exposure across group accounting. You will work closely with senior finance colleagues, providing excellent scope to develop your accounting and month-end experience. Hybrid work is available after your probation period (which will be office-based), as well as a workplace pension, healthcare, 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays and parking.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
